completion_meaning: P1采集与核查任务完成；不表示所有录像/许可/校外权限齐全，不表示全文精读、课程正文或实验完成。

states.registered: 原有44项全部有P1核查结论；详细新增来源在7个分片
states.acquired: 以实际file/hash计；缺失或断链为null，不以URL登记充下载
states.read: 逐源read_scope与论文actualReading/actualRead限定；不称全文精读
states.reviewed: 采集分片审核加Main跨源核对；A5三封面和版本差异独立复核
states.accepted: 本次结构/哈希/链接、页面入口与构建；没有课程实验执行验收

browser.surface: Vite development server at 127.0.0.1:5411; production build separately passed
browser.resources_table: Viewed desktop/mobile; table-local horizontal scrolling, no page-level overflow

runtime.configuration: task.perCallModel on via supported session override, not persisted

publication_boundary: Only course metadata/resources/status and lightweight provenance/reviews/plans/checks are committed. Raw PDFs, caption bodies, extracted fulltexts and other unlicensed raw archives stay local under the existing sources ignore convention. Local acquisition is not a remote backup claim.
git_delivery: Commit and push result is reported separately after actual execution; no guessed commit or deployment status is recorded here.
